label: Call-centre emotions
use_case: Our call centre wants software that listens to our agents' calls and flags when they sound stressed, frustrated or bored, so team leads can coach them and track mood scores.

verdict.disclaimer: A first-pass classification from your answers, not legal advice.

matched.title: Emotion recognition at work or in education
matched.note: Exception for medical or safety reasons only.

matched.title: Biometrics (remote identification, categorisation, emotion recognition)
matched.note: Annex III high-risk obligations apply from 2 Dec 2027 (moved from 2 Aug 2026 by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744, fixed date). Conservative: any emotion inference from biometric data is treated as Annex III 1(c). Biometrics often needs a notified body (Art. 43(1)).

matched.title: AI literacy
matched.note: Applies to every provider and deployer. Wording softened by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744; no specific literacy level is required.

obligations.text: Do not sell, deploy or use this in the EU.
Train staff who run or use the AI, and keep a record.
